proposed.text: When an enclosed area is at least 10 m2 and connected lighting load exceeds 10 W/m2, what control capability does DOE require?

options.text: Only emergency lights may be switched.
The lighting load must be reducible by at least 50 percent while maintaining reasonably uniform illuminance.
The area must use one fixed full-output circuit only.

proposed.rationale: The lighting load must be reducible by at least 50 percent while maintaining reasonably uniform illuminance. This answer matches DOE Guidelines refined markdown lines 323-405.
